browser_matrix: Existing CI builds Web but specifies no browser engines or browser runtime tests. Local Chromium is additional observation, not a newly declared support restriction.
tolerance_policy: Use existing Go test thresholds for discrete outcomes. Three local repeats measure variability only; zero variance does not justify zero cross-engine tolerance. Position/rotation/timing/perceptual/performance tolerances remain pending paired review.

scenarios.title: Startup, title, pause and resume
scenarios.setup_and_inputs: Fresh disposable profile; start game, Play, Esc, resume, return to title and restart.
scenarios.expected: Same menu text, focus, control locking and pause behavior; no duplicated world or handlers.
scenarios.comparison: UI screenshots and playthrough

scenarios.title: Landfall and asset identities
scenarios.setup_and_inputs: Load source and packed assets; visit arrival pads, gate, market, lower decks and crew deck.
scenarios.expected: Same logical IDs, transforms, colliders, ladders, lamps and external packed resources.
scenarios.comparison: Manifest/pack tests and matching captures

scenarios.title: Terrain, scatter, streaming and maps
scenarios.setup_and_inputs: Walk/drive across chunk boundaries; teleport among settlements; compare map markers and terrain samples.
scenarios.expected: Same seeded placement/heights, map coordinates, draw distances and collision coverage.
scenarios.comparison: Tests, deterministic fixtures and route trace

scenarios.title: Walking, running, braking and turning
scenarios.setup_and_inputs: Walk, run, reverse direction, stop, jump and land on flat ground and slopes.
scenarios.expected: Same acceleration/braking/turning and airborne control within measured bounds.
scenarios.comparison: Existing tests plus fixed-step movement trace (pending)

scenarios.title: Traversal and collision boundaries
scenarios.setup_and_inputs: Run the Hull vault, mantle, stairs, duct slide, crouch, roll, ladder and wall-kick routes; test blocked alternatives.
scenarios.expected: Identical success/rejection and input consumption; existing Go test thresholds apply.
scenarios.comparison: Existing traversal tests and route clips (pending)

scenarios.title: Render cadence, pauses and focus
scenarios.setup_and_inputs: Repeat inputs at 30/60/97/240 render Hz and multi-tick frames; pause mid-jump/drive, resume, lose/regain focus.
scenarios.expected: Each edge input consumed once; no paused drift or jump on resuming.
scenarios.comparison: Existing tests plus variable-cadence replay (pending)

scenarios.title: All real vehicle cornering
scenarios.setup_and_inputs: Replay vehicle-inputs.json on every world.json vehicle, three fresh runs, 60 Hz.
scenarios.expected: Every real variant reaches minimum up.Y >= 0.8 as required by the Go test; record speed and trajectory separately.
scenarios.comparison: Go/Rust JSON traces and source test

scenarios.title: Drive, brake, reverse, enter/exit and parking
scenarios.setup_and_inputs: For buggy, bike, trike, rover, hauler and tanker: enter, accelerate, brake, reverse, attempt blocked/fast exits, park, toggle H, recover with R.
scenarios.expected: Same prompts, control response, gears, seat/hand/foot poses and lamp/parking behavior.
scenarios.comparison: Source tests and hands-on route

scenarios.title: People and solid obstacles
scenarios.setup_and_inputs: Repeat full-rate and reduced-rate pedestrian impacts, nearby misses, walls and parked-vehicle collisions, forward and reverse.
scenarios.expected: Same injury thresholds, push response and obstacle protection; every vehicle tested independently.
scenarios.comparison: Source tests and contact traces (pending)

scenarios.title: Animation, body and wardrobe

scenarios.expected: Same asset selections, hidden meshes, skin tones, timing, blends and bone placement.
scenarios.comparison: Go-derived row/menu tests and live native/browser wardrobe evidence in step-6-wardrobe; matched animation/foot placement captures pending
